messages:
Sara: heads up — after flipping quantized reranker v2 to staging, short-query nDCG looks fine but MRR on long queries (>128 tokens) is down ~3.2% over the 2k eval cohort.
Jin: cohort + sampling details?
Sara: cohort = prod-sampled-candidates v2 filtered query_len>128 & doc_len>256, 2k queries stratified by query freq; nDCG@10 delta ~ -0.1, MRR@10 delta ~ -3.2%, rough p≈0.03
Omar: did you run bootstrap? small cohorts can be noisy for MRR, especially long-tail
Sara: ran 1k bootstrap earlier; 95% CI for MRR delta = [-4.6%, -1.1%] so feels real, distribution skewed — a few queries drive most of the drop
EvalBot: ran bootstrap 10k on /staging/quant-v2 for that cohort — mean_mrr_diff = -0.0305, 95CI = [-0.048, -0.013], p=0.002 :bar_chart:
Nina: could be priming-length or tokenizer truncation interacting with quantization (embedding scale shifts). Did we check kv-cache truncation and tokenization parity between float vs quant builds?
Jin: also check per-query logits variance; quant can compress logits and change softmax tail behavior
Omar: proposal: run three probes — 1) balanced 10k holdout float vs quant; 2) per-query logits variance comparison & top1 doc churn; 3) try re-scaling embeddings/logits and re-eval
Sara: starting balanced 10k now, and a short-priming probe (reduce priming to 64 tokens) to isolate context length effect
Nina: quick bootstrap helper if useful:
```\nimport numpy as np\ndef ci_bootstrap(values, n=10000):\n  res = []\n  for _ in range(n):\n    s = np.random.choice(values, size=len(values), replace=True)\n    res.append(np.mean(s))\n  return np.percentile(res, [2.5, 97.5])\n```
Jin: :thumbsup: also capture tokenization histogram + candidate order snapshots for the cohort
EvalBot: enqueued job run-326a for balanced-10k + priming-64 probe — will post when complete :white_check_mark:
Sara: if effect persists we'll try per-channel quant vs per-tensor and a small logits rescale (multiply logits by 1.02-1.10) before softmax, see if that recovers MRR
Omar: please record seeds & sampling protocol in the eval metadata — reproducibility is vital here
Nina: on it — updating eval-harness PR to emit sampling_seed, tokenizer_version, priming_len flag
Sara: thanks everyone — will post interim results when EvalBot finishes
